agent_explanation: Velocity-error law with kp~25.68 demands >fmax, so nominal command saturates at fmax=104.557 (counterfactual shows exactly 104.557). With noise=0.271, reported force is 135.924, ~31 above limit. Likely cause: seeded sensor noise is applied to the measured state/velocity error after (or outside) the fmax saturation/clamp, so the noisy correction is never re-clamped to fmax.
